name: Cathleen

attributes.attribute: an English spelling of the Irish name Caitlín
a form Yeats used in naming Cathleen Ni Houlihan

text: Cathleen is the English spelling of an Irish name usually written Caitlín. W. B. Yeats chose Cathleen Ni Houlihan for his version of Caitlín Ní hUallacháin. His play made this form widely known. The name also marks a spot on the map. Assaroe, a waterfall of the River Erne, also bears the name Cathleen's Falls.

okr.objective: Define Cathleen as an English form of Caitlín and a place name.
key_results: Record Cathleen as the English spelling of Caitlín.
